blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.search` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method searches across entities. Per entity, results come from the
Search Module when that entity is indexed; otherwise each entity is queried
with the same free-text `q` filter the list endpoints support.

Results are grouped per entity and paginated independently.

children.name: entity
children.description:
The entities / indexes to search, comma-separated.
When the Search Module is enabled, defaults to every registered index.
Otherwise defaults to the admin fallback entity set.

Per entity, an index is used when one exists; otherwise the request falls
back to `query.graph` for that entity only.

children.name: limit
children.description: Per entity, not across the response — each group paginates on its own.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before the results. Used for pagination.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

blocks.html:
This method retrieves the registered search indexes, their status, and the
fields each stores. `enabled` is `false` when the Search Module is not
configured.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: name
children.description: Unique index name, as used in `query.search({ entity })`.

children.name: entity
children.description: The `query.graph` entrypoint used to hydrate non-indexed fields.

children.name: provider
children.description: Identifier of the provider backing this index.

children.name: fields
children.description: Leaf fields stored in the index.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Whether the Search Module is enabled. When `false`, `search_indexes` is empty.

blocks.html:
This method triggers rebuilding a search index from its seed. The rebuild runs in
the background - check the index's `status` through [listIndexes](/references/js_sdk/admin/Search/methods/js_sdk.admin.Search.listIndexes) to know
when it's done.

types.name: id
types.description: The name of the index to reindex.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: job_id
children.description: Identifier of the triggered reindex job.

children.name: indexes
children.description: Names of the indexes being reindexed.
